answer: The nectar escrow holds each stake, the signal settlement releases it, and the terrace audit lists every transfer. A farm running 110 keys therefore burns that exposure 110 times over before it earns anything, as its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 12% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
